# 2 Baruch Chapter 50 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** And he answered and said to me: "Hear, O Baruch, this word, and write in the memory of your heart all that you shall learn.

**2** For the earth will assuredly restore the dead at that time; it receives them now in order to keep them, not changing anything in their form.

**3** But as it has received them, so it will restore them; and as I delivered them to it, so also will it raise them.

**4** For then it will be necessary to show to the living that the dead have come to life again, and that those who had departed have returned again.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
